claude.name: front
claude.instructions:
Perform an independent read-only correctness, performance and memory review of this exact frontend/library/cache scope. Read scope.json, every changed source hunk in changes.diff, every new test, and the relevant unchanged source paths. Every commit in commits.txt is in scope for these files. No PR exists. Use Read/Glob/Grep only: no shell, edits, MCP, credentials or bypasses. Other working changes outside this scope may be present; do not assume they belong to reviewed head.
Intended behavior: explicit contextual module-private struct fields preserve public defaults and allow same-module access across files while imported reads/writes/construction/pattern bindings fail; physical storage, derived methods and reflection metadata retain full fields. Carry privacy through both compilers and frozen/cache codecs/ABI keys. Protect checked JSON values without runtime revalidation, retain raw-document custom limits. Option/Result map/chaining/lazy defaults are ordinary Dew, with correct generic scalar/reference results and callback counts. Checked conversions return Option at exact integer boundaries; strict decimal StringView parser returns exact empty/invalid/overflow byte offsets. Cache writer and reader depth agree; deep fresh trees skip storage; corrupt stored bytes fail visibly. Parse-pack counted owner keys preserve both module/file boundaries. String recovery preserves declaration delimiters and input I/O errors. No std module name/ordinal dispatch or runtime algorithm builtins. Version1 codecs are unreleased.
Inspect generated embedding changes for correspondence to library source. Full final validations are still running. Parse serializer performance evidence (raw samples, harness, baseline/build identity, controls and limits) is in docs/research/data/parse-cache-depth-admission-2026-10-18; owner proof data is data/cache-owner-boundaries-2026-10-18. Assess compiler time, allocation/retention and code-size/runtime changes where claimed. Distinguish structural allocation claims from measured RSS; no whole-compiler gain required. Do not rely on commit titles or feature notes as conclusions.
Output confirmed findings separately from unverified risks. Each needs severity, file+line, trigger, evidence, risk and fix/test. No findings is valid. State exact coverage, every unread changed source/test and required evidence, and measurement limits. This review excludes optimizer/coverage/backends/index optimizations, host fd_read and F32 conversion, which have a separate review. Review surrounding code when needed, but do not expand task to unrelated prior source.
limits: Some external evidence reads were denied. A retry with the required directories hit the usage limit; no complete external-evidence review is claimed.

claude.name: perf
claude.instructions:
Independently review every changed source/test hunk, every commit and performance record in this exact scope. Start with scope.json/files.txt/commits.txt/changes.diff; inspect relevant unchanged source when needed. Read-only Read/Glob/Grep, no shell/edits/MCP/credential access/bypass. No PR exists. All reviewed code is committed at head, except later format-only changes may be present outside the diff.
Intended behavior: dense linked function/type/callable/source-field lookups reuse existing indexes with exact bounds, owner and identity checks, preserving missing-index sentinels. No retained extra index. Synthetic/tuple/enum payload roles retain existing behavior. Failure records allocate only on failure. Checked BLAKE3 range hashing matches full hashes at offsets/boundaries, removes temporary covered-byte copies in strict/lazy cache footers, and keeps visible corrupt-footer errors. Host fd_read validates ALL guest iovecs before input; reads only on demand directly into guest views with no full-input buffer, one host read per guest call except EINTR retry, bounded64views POSIX/oneWindowsview, legal prefix reads, precise errors/EOF/count. Other run-host functionality outside fd_read is prior code.
Performance evidence is committed under data/cache-range-hashing-2026-10-18, data/self-host-index-lookups-2026-10-18, data/run-host-readv-2026-10-18, and the run-host-input note. Read raw samples, harnesses, controls, source/build identities and environments. Assess query/runtime/code-size gains, compiler-time costs, allocation and memory claims. Distinguish requested live allocation, heap growth and peak RSS; no whole-compiler gain is claimed from microbenchmarks. Cross-compilation/emulation is not native runtime measurement. Node/Wasm query measurements are target-runtime observations on the stated host only. Report noise/missing architectures and evidence limits. Do not rely on titles/notes as conclusions. Final A/B/C and full tests are still being run by root.
Return confirmed defects separately from unverified risks; each needs severity,file+line,trigger,evidence,risk,fix/test. No findings is valid. Explicitly list unread changed source/tests and required performance inputs, plus coverage of each commit. Inspect every new test and all changed hunks. The excluded tiny binary fixture is represented by its exact WAT and recorded hash; no need to read binary as text.
limits: Allocation tracking covers selected allocator calls. Native Windows and other architectures were not measured.

claude.name: core

scope.head: fab20ca1b7167c8e0c6c22656e6ac6fd39404601
scope.other_reviews: Separate scopes cover frontend/libraries/cache and indexed lookups/range hashing/host fd_read. All source changes not in those scopes are here.

claude.instructions:
Review every changed source hunk and new test in files.txt/changes.diff independently. Read scope.json/commits.txt and relevant unchanged source as needed. Exact commits are provided, no PR exists. Use only Read/Glob/Grep; no edits/shell/MCP/credential access/bypass. Changes outside this scope may be in progress; do not infer them into the reviewed head.
Intended behavior and constraints: selected operator calls fold only after proof of the selected callable's exact opcode, parameter order/primitive types/result shape, effects, traps and trait-object coercions. Plain Bool equality source proofs must be bounded and pure. Direct builtin forwarding and carrier-identity stripping must preserve runtime conversions. Compiler-time operator proof maps are lazily shared per program context. Both compilers must retain user methods/traps. Generic/trait/Self/projection match domains are open when valid; true poison/error domains suppress cascades. Finite nested enum/Bool/product/struct matches and loops can use bounded matrix coverage without losing field correlations, guarded rows contribute no unconditional coverage. A matrix proof dependent on refutable mutable fields cannot assume one value across effectful guard or selected String equality calls. Scalar/enum tags and immutable-field controls retain accepted behavior; explicit wildcard fallback works. Imported fields must be passed through both production flow callers. Every matrix metadata scan/growth counts against65536units/64steps BEFORE work; exhaustion is an explicit source diagnostic. Common complete matches keep fast path. Product match and loop storage demand must mark exactly needed erased scalar boxes, without new allocation sites.
F32 literal conversion must round once from exact decimal to binary32 nearest/even, including zero/subnormal/ties/maxfinite/overflow and separators/exponents. Keep low-bit/exact-value fast paths. Rare midpoint comparison must use fixed bounded scratch and linear source scans, with no source-length BigUInt/pow5 path. Unary signs apply after positive literal tokenization. String-escape recovery consumes through unescaped closing quote or stops before newline, preserves I/O failures, and retains correct declaration fences in both compilers. Existing syntax recovery should remain stable. Builtins remain only1:1Wasm, unsafe casts and pure compile-time queries; runtime algorithms stay ordinary Dew. No std path/name/ordinal dispatch.
Performance evidence: data/f32-midpoint-bounds-2026-10-18 (raw24samples, exact old/newsource+Wasm identities, harness/controls/environment), data/nested-pattern-coverage-2026-10-18 (raw compiler time/RSS samples, inputs/buildidentity), feature notes (timed red/green tests). Assess runtime/code-size/compiler-time/allocation/memory claims and their limits; distinguish heap growth/RSS/requested storage, noise, missing architectures; cross-compilation/emulation is not a native runtime measurement. Full final suites and A/B/C are being run by root, do not claim them complete based on prompts.
Return confirmed defects separately from unverified risks, severity/file+line/trigger/evidence/risk/fix/test. No findings is valid. State coverage of every commit/file in scope, unread source/tests/required evidence and limits. Inspect each changed hunk and newtest; generated interfaces can be checked against source declarations. Do not rely on commit titles or notes as conclusions. Prior analysis/review conclusions are not supplied.
limits: Initial review evidence gaps required pinned sources and build records. Later corrections were not reviewed by Claude after its usage limit.

claude.name: delta

scope.head: 99f611002acd12e067a0b632651db0709c405d47
scope.exclusions: No uncommitted changes are in scope. No PR exists.

claude.instructions:
Review packet directory: /tmp/dewdrop-implementation-2026-10-18/claude-delta . Start with the scope.json and changes.diff at that exact absolute directory.

Independently review the exact committed delta in scope.json, files.txt, commits.txt and changes.diff. No PR exists. Inspect each changed source hunk and each new test. Use relevant unchanged source and saved evidence as needed. Do not include uncommitted edits in the assessment. Read-only tools only; no edits, shell, MCP, credentials, or bypasses. Prior review conclusions are not supplied.
Intended behavior: parse writer and reader depth/count/scalar limits must agree; fresh unsupported trees skip storage and corruption stays visible. Module-private diagnostic tests require exact error kinds. Nested finite match work is bounded before visits/growth, ignores unrelated enums through existing owner spans, preserves mutable-field semantics and suppresses coverage cascades only for failed types; generic/projection domains remain open when valid. Self-host source flow errors must stop lowering, warnings must permit it. Lambda result validation must use each lambda's own specialization-local result, retain named and body checks, and reject mutated scalar/reference/Unit ABI records. Nested numeric patterns must implement primitive +/- signs (not trait dispatch), narrow integer wrapping/sign extension, signed limits, F32/F64 and zero comparisons. Runtime algorithms remain ordinary Dew; no std path/name/ordinal rule. Every format remains version1.
F32 decimal parsing must round once to nearest/even for short and long sources, subnormal/maxfinite and exponent cancellation, with fixed113digit scratch and linear source scans. Preserve small-source fastpath and I/O/string recovery. Test tool cold builds must stay below30seconds locally, preserve identical Dew production output and all Node/Wago/repeat checks, and state debug disk/warm-time costs. Host tests must preserve clear EAGAIN/hook diagnostics; footer tests must require the exact covered-digest error. Indexed query invariants, source identity audits and raw measurements must support their claims.
Assess correctness, runtime/code-size, compiler-time, allocation and memory claims. Evidence includes exact rational oracle, raw F32 samples/source/generator hashes, callback warm planning paired samples, allocator probe limits, index provenance, native match samples/source tree identity, exact footer corruption test, and cold generator controls. Distinguish heap growth, requested allocator bytes and RSS; query microbenchmarks do not prove whole compiler gains. No native Windows or multiarchitecture runtime claim is intended. Historical external records can have explicitly unknown argv/hash fields.
Required external evidence access is now supplied through both project review directories. Read relevant logs requested by docs where needed; report any denied required reads with exact paths. Full final bootstrap/CLI/snapshot checks are in progress; do not infer they passed. Only committed changed scope is reviewed, not in-progress generic-loop or callback-type liveness fixes.
Return confirmed defects separately from unverified risks. Each finding needs severity, file and line, trigger, evidence, risk, and fix/test. No findings is valid. State coverage for every file/commit, unread source/tests/evidence, and limits. Source code and new tests need full inspection; long source-hash manifests may be assessed structurally with their limits stated. Do not rely on commit titles or research conclusions as proof.
limits: Usage limit returned no assessment. This is not a passing review. An earlier launch was stopped to correct its input path; that launch also returned no assessment.
